Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE newly composed original narrative illustration, not a collage, not a sheet, no inset portrait or lettering.
Drawing direction: Nightglass.
Input images: Image 1: Actual earlier new encounter frame NG03; preserve identity, equipment, creature construction, geography and persistent state. New action and camera.
Image 2: Riven identity and current drawing/impact treatment; create new choreography.
Image 3: Original full Nightglass; drawing and world benchmark, not cast selection
Image 4: Recurring adult identity and saber construction only
Current subject, place and power constraints: Riven is the same light-skinned adult man with silver swept hair, teal long combat coat, black armor and a single cyan-edged saber in his RIGHT hand. New rival Vey is a light-skinned adult woman about33, angular face, short black hair, ash-white fitted combat armor, short wine-red cape, a single long black-shaft hooked glaive held with both hands. They fight on a dry pale bridge terrace: tall arch at LEFT, low parapet and open sky at RIGHT, one dark banner behind the arch. Keep the fight axis and the same light direction across views, without identical cameras. Borrowed Beat stores a brief pulse only after Riven's metal blade contacts the enemy weapon; it must discharge through the next weapon contact and cannot heal injury. No other combatants. New actions, no reuse of the old airborne-opponent composition.
Requested image: X01 The bind, drawn as a cut; standalone. Camera: extreme close graphic.
Show the same NG03 reversal in a genuinely new extreme close composition. Riven's strained face, RIGHT saber to glaive contact, and Vey's compressed shoulder/face dominate. Flatten supporting architecture into a broad ivory field and sharply cut black directional shapes; cyan stays concentrated at metal contact. Keep exact actors, equipment and cracked LEFT guard but allow deliberate speed abstraction. The impulse should read through the opponent's distorted posture, not a giant flash.
Art direction: beautiful memorable adult faces, decisive gesture and readable body mechanics. Preserve the original reference drawing treatment and recent quiet surfaces. Clear force, contact, body response and purposeful negative space. Dry ground in broad matte light/shadow planes; no reflective floor, tiny tile tessellation, all-over scratches, grain, crack webs, microfacets or sparkle. Selective detail belongs at faces, grips, joints and decisive contact. Keep material differences and intentional broad brushwork. Restrained effects with a clear direction; no generic aura, particle storm or rubble carpet. Continuous intact weapon construction with understandable grips. Draw only physically plausible limbs, deliberate occlusion, no floating props. No text, labels, watermark, speech balloons, split panels or franchise copies. Aspect ratio: landscape 3:2.
